summary: Learn Ruby, Rails MVC, Active Record, and Minitest through guided coding exercises. Explore the 10-day foundation course and build a working feature.
lede: Ruby on Rails development connects Ruby, MVC request flow, routing, and Active Record to build web application features. For aspiring Rails developers, web developers, and technical support professionals, the course offers hands-on practice building and testing a small application. Learners create routes and controllers, render ERB views, define migrations and model relationships, validate input, write Minitest checks, track changes with Git, and manually verify AI-assisted code suggestions.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for people beginning to build or support Ruby on Rails applications, including technical professionals who need to follow application changes and work with developers.
prerequisites: Basic computer use and comfort managing files are expected. No prior Ruby or Rails experience is required. Coding is required during the exercises; bring a laptop with permission to install or access Ruby, Rails, Git, and a code editor.
